import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_public_school_enrollment_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 203.20', header=None)
# States start after row 'State' (row index 10, excel row 11) up to row before 'Bureau of Indian Education'
state_start = df[df[0] == 'State'].index[0] + 1
state_end = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Bureau of Indian')].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[state_start:state_end].copy()
# Column Z is projected percent change 2022 to 2031 (index 25)
proj_col = 25
states_df[proj_col] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[proj_col], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=proj_col, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_public_school_enrollment_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 203.20', header=None)
state_start = df[df[0] == 'State'].index[0] + 1
state_end = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Bureau of Indian')].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[state_start:state_end].copy()
# Column T is percent change 2017 to 2022 (index 19)
pct_col = 19
states_df[pct_col] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[pct_col], errors='coerce')
result = int((states_df[pct_col] > 0).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_public_school_enrollment_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 203.20', header=None)
regions = ['Northeast', 'Midwest', 'South', 'West']
fall_2022_col = [c for c in df.columns if df.iloc[2, c] == 'Fall 2022'][0]
region_vals = df[df[0].isin(regions)][fall_2022_col].astype(float)
result = float(region_vals.mean())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_public_school_enrollment_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 203.20', header=None)

col_2022 = None
for r in range(5):
    for c in df.columns:
        if 'Fall 2022' in str(df.iloc[r, c]):
            col_2022 = c
            break
    if col_2022 is not None:
        break

ne_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'northeast'].index[0]
mw_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'midwest'].index[0]

ne_val = float(df.iloc[ne_row, col_2022])
mw_val = float(df.iloc[mw_row, col_2022])

result = 'Midwest' if mw_val > ne_val else 'Northeast'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_public_school_enrollment_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 203.20', header=None)

col_2019, col_2020 = None, None
for r in range(5):
    for c in df.columns:
        val = str(df.iloc[r, c])
        if 'Fall 2019' in val:
            col_2019 = c
        if 'Fall 2020' in val:
            col_2020 = c

us_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'united states'].index[0]
val_2019 = float(df.iloc[us_row, col_2019])
val_2020 = float(df.iloc[us_row, col_2020])

result = 'yes' if val_2020 < val_2019 else 'no'
